factualRecord.variant: Supine chest lift with knees bent, legs together and hands behind the head
factualRecord.start: Lie on the back with knees bent and legs together. Interlace fingers behind the head, press the head lightly into the hands, and keep elbows within peripheral view.
factualRecord.move: Exhale to lift head, neck and chest, looking toward the thighs, until shoulder-blade tips leave the mat.
factualRecord.return: Pause while inhaling, then exhale to lower to the mat.
contacts: Head lightly supported by the hands at setup.
Mat contact changes as the shoulder-blade tips lift.
factualRecord.props: A mat is referenced; no additional prop is specified for this section.
factualRecord.side: A central lift with both hands is described; no rotation or alternating side is specified.
